header.label: Comparisons
header.title: Open source alternatives
header.desc: Honest, factual comparisons between OpenAEC tools and commercial software in the construction industry. No marketing — just facts so you can choose what fits best.

why.title: Why comparisons?
why.p1: Open source software is often viewed as an inferior alternative to commercial tools. That's a misconception. For many applications in the AEC industry, open source alternatives are now mature, fast and complete — often with better support for open standards like IFC, BCF and IDS.
why.p2: At the same time, commercial tools sometimes really are the right choice. They have years of polish, large ecosystems and proven integrations. We believe in fair comparisons so you can make an informed choice — whether you choose open source, commercial or both.

bluebeam.label: PDF markup
bluebeam.desc: Open PDF Studio versus Bluebeam Revu — compare PDF annotation, measurement tools, redaction and collaboration. Which fits your workflow better?

solibri.label: BIM validation
solibri.desc: BIM Validator, BCF Manager Studio and Monty IFC Viewer versus Solibri Office — IFC validation and model checking with open standards.

autocad.label: 2D CAD
autocad.desc: Open 2D Studio versus AutoCAD LT — 2D drafting with layers, dimensions and DXF export. Cross-platform, built with Rust and Tauri.

bimcollab.label: BCF collaboration
bimcollab.desc: BCF Manager Studio versus BIMcollab — issue management for BIM projects with BCF 2.1 and BCF API 3.0. Self-hosted or cloud, your choice.

bouwprijs.label: Cost estimation (NL)
bouwprijs.desc: Open Calc Studio versus Bouwprijs and IBIS-Trad — Dutch construction cost estimation with STABU and RAW support, plus AI integration via MCP.

dragon.label: Speech recognition
dragon.desc: Open Speech Studio versus Dragon NaturallySpeaking — dictate and transcribe with Whisper AI, fully local on your own machine instead of a license costing several hundred euros.
